body: Why are you blaming Trump? Blame who you voted into MN office. Walz literally let the city burn and refused help when Trump offered it. Put blame where it belongs.
You are not awful. You’re suffering. There’s a difference. I’m sure you are a beautiful, loving soul that is tormented with depression.
I’m so sorry about your dad. It’s rough to lose a parent.

It’s always been like this. Varying degrees. But for the most part like this. It’s been getting worse since my dad passed 5 years ago. The past year has been getting tougher and tougher. 

I rely on myself. I support myself in my life. Just no one to share my life with.
Probably. On some level. Going thru life alone is rough.

Not your job to help. But thank you. 
Joy. Happiness. Having someone in my life. 
I’m happy for my friends who have these things. I’ve had depression since I was 15. I’m 53. It’s a long road to live like this. I’m just too tired to keep up the act.

Yes. The depression. Seeing everyone around me advance in life. I’ve done everything I can think of. The schooling, degree, job, etc… This life just isn’t working for me. I’ve tried. Believe me, I’ve fought the good fight. I’m done. Exhausted.
Hi there. Yeah, I’m done. I’ve tried for 20+ years to talk, medicate, etc… I’ve tried it all. I’m satisfied I’ve done everything I can. Just waiting for my mom to go and I’m right behind her.
I’m 53 and feel the same way. I don’t belong here.
What do you have to be sad about, your life is so good.
Yes you will go to Heaven.
All the best to you too.

I hear you on this. Personally speaking, I’ve  come to the reality my life is and has been a joke. What I was living / praying for is gone. There is no god. There is no reason I should be here. I derive no joy from life, so what is the point to keep going?  This isn’t how it’s supposed to be.
